#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Inspect report.pdf: existence, page count, page size, and metadata."""
from pypdf import PdfReader

reader = PdfReader("report.pdf")
print("Pages:", len(reader.pages))
first = reader.pages[0]
box = first.mediabox
print("First page size: %.2f x %.2f points (%.2f x %.2f inches)" % (
    float(box.width), float(box.height),
    float(box.width) / 72.0, float(box.height) / 72.0))
meta = reader.metadata
print("Metadata title:", meta.title if meta else None)

# Show a short text preview of page 1 (first 200 chars) if extractable
try:
    text = first.extract_text() or ""
    print("Page 1 text preview:", repr(text[:200]))
except Exception as exc:  # pragma: no cover - informational
    print("Text extraction skipped:", exc)

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Find report.pdf, list the workspace, and probe all python interpreters for PDF libs."""
import glob
import os
import subprocess
import sys

print("=== Current directory ===")
for entry in sorted(os.listdir(".")):
    print(" ", entry)

print("\n=== report.pdf search (cwd) ===")
for pattern in ["report.pdf", "*.pdf"]:
    for path in sorted(glob.glob(pattern)):
        size = os.path.getsize(path)
        print(f"  {path} ({size} bytes)")

print("\n=== candidate pythons ===")
candidates = [
    sys.executable,
    "/usr/bin/python3",
    "/usr/local/bin/python3",
    "/opt/conda/bin/python",
    os.path.expanduser("~/anaconda3/bin/python"),
    os.path.expanduser("~/miniconda3/bin/python"),
]
seen = set()
for cand in candidates:
    if not cand or cand in seen:
        continue
    seen.add(cand)
    if not os.path.exists(cand):
        continue
    try:
        out = subprocess.run(
            [cand, "-c", "import sys; print(sys.version.split()[0])"],
            capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=20,
        )
        ver = out.stdout.strip() or "?"
        print(f"  {cand} -> python {ver}")
    except Exception as exc:
        print(f"  {cand} -> error {exc}")

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Confirm pypdf API surface needed for cover-page creation."""
import subprocess
import textwrap

code = textwrap.dedent("""
    import pypdf
    from pypdf.generic import DictionaryObject, NameObject, DecodedStreamObject, ArrayObject
    print("add_blank_page:", hasattr(pypdf.PdfWriter, "add_blank_page"))
    print("DecodedStreamObject.set_data:", hasattr(DecodedStreamObject, "set_data"))
    print("DecodedStreamObject.setData:", hasattr(DecodedStreamObject, "setData"))
    print("PdfWriter.add_page:", hasattr(pypdf.PdfWriter, "add_page"))

    # Quick smoke test: build a tiny PDF in memory
    w = pypdf.PdfWriter()
    page = w.add_blank_page(width=612, height=792)
    stream = DecodedStreamObject()
    if hasattr(stream, "set_data"):
        stream.set_data(b"BT /F1 12 Tf 72 720 Td (hello) Tj ET")
    else:
        stream.setData(b"BT /F1 12 Tf 72 720 Td (hello) Tj ET")
    font = DictionaryObject()
    font[NameObject("/Type")] = NameObject("/Font")
    font[NameObject("/Subtype")] = NameObject("/Type1")
    font[NameObject("/BaseFont")] = NameObject("/Helvetica")
    fonts = DictionaryObject()
    fonts[NameObject("/F1")] = font
    res = DictionaryObject()
    res[NameObject("/Font")] = fonts
    page[NameObject("/Contents")] = stream
    page[NameObject("/Resources")] = res
    with open("smoke_test.pdf", "wb") as fh:
        w.write(fh)
    r = pypdf.PdfReader("smoke_test.pdf")
    print("smoke test pages:", len(r.pages))
    print("smoke test text:", repr((r.pages[0].extract_text() or "").strip()))
""")

result = subprocess.run(["/usr/bin/python3", "-c", code], capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=60)
print("STDOUT:\n" + result.stdout)
if result.stderr:
    print("STDERR:\n" + result.stderr[:2000])
print("exit code:", result.returncode)
